sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Silver Tree of Life Evil Eye Bracelet
sourceNotes.rawContent: Celebrate growth and protection with this stunning Tree of Life evil eye bracelet. Featuring sparkling crystal accents, this high-fashion statement piece maintains its radiant silver-toned luster best when kept away from moisture and perfumes. Store in a dry, safe place after each wear to preserve its brilliant finish.
